column1: # ZAP baseline rules (.github/workflows/zap-baseline.yml). Format: rule id<TAB>FAIL|WARN|IGNORE<TAB>(name — reason).
# Target: the production build started inside the job (http://localhost:3200, demo seed).
# FAIL fails the run; WARN is reported only (-I); rules not listed keep ZAP's default (WARN).
# Every IGNORE / downgrade carries its reason. Review this file when a rule starts firing.
# HTTPS-only rules (10011 Secure cookie flag, 10035 HSTS) never fire over http://localhost;
# they stay FAIL for a staging scan and are asserted by tests/e2e/security-headers.spec.ts.

column3: (Vulnerable JS Library — a known-vulnerable bundled library blocks go-live)
(Cookie No HttpOnly Flag — NEXT_LOCALE, cookie_consent and announcement_dismissed must be readable by browser code and hold no secret; session and cart cookies are HttpOnly)
(Cookie Without Secure Flag — https only; cookies are Secure when APP_URL is https)
(Missing Anti-clickjacking Header — X-Frame-Options DENY + frame-ancestors on every response)
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing)
(Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set — https only)
(Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set — every page gets the policy from src/proxy.ts)
(Secure Pages Include Mixed Content)
(Cookie without SameSite Attribute — all first-party cookies are Lax; reported to catch regressions)
(CSP: script-src/style-src 'unsafe-inline' — accepted for Next.js inline bootstrap/RSC scripts, ADR-0024)
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set)
(Timestamp Disclosure — build ids, cache timestamps and epoch values in the RSC payload, not server clock leaks)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration — reported; no credentialed CORS is configured)
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens — forms post to Server Actions, which check Origin/Host (§12 CSRF); no classic form tokens exist)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments — words like "TODO"/"admin" inside minified framework bundles)
(Modern Web Application — informational: tells ZAP to use the AJAX spider, which the scan already does)
(Storable and Cacheable Content — catalogue pages and hashed static assets are cached on purpose, §14.1)
(Base64 Disclosure — blur placeholders and the RSC payload are base64/opaque by design; no secrets are rendered)
(Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre Vulnerability — COOP is same-origin; COEP would break third-party images/tags)
(Loosely Scoped Cookie — cookies are host-only)
